environment.gpu: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M5, Unspecified Version)

assetConstruction.approach: Programmatic greybox region: 10 height-displaced terrain chunks (296 subdivisions each) + 22 landmarks, exported at runtime to binary glTF (GLB) with unused UVs retained.
assetConstruction.exportCaveat: Export happens on the main thread at scenario start and is reported separately from load time. A production pipeline would export offline.

regionLoading.heapSampling: Chrome performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize sampled every 50ms; coarse JS-heap proxy, not process RSS, and no forced GC.
regionLoading.preloadCaveat: The GLB is already a Blob in memory (generated in-page), so preload measures parse/container creation only, not network transfer. A real 50MB download must be added to the load-gate budget.

findings: AssetContainer preloading keeps all 33 loaded meshes out of the scene: scene mesh count stayed at 73 until addAllToScene.
addAllToScene/removeAllFromScene are sub-millisecond operations; the real cost is deferred GPU upload and shader compilation on the first rendered frame.
Without a masked warmup, the first reveal frame spiked to ~203-233ms. Waiting for materials and rendering three frames while the gate is still black reduced the reveal max frame to 36ms.
Cold run masked warmup was ~1.14s; a second run in the same page (asset cached, shaders already compiled) had a peak JS heap of ~201.8MB and a 35ms reveal max frame.
region-gate loaded two containers (A/B) and swapped them while fully masked. The swap itself took 0.3-0.6ms; reveal max frame was 35.5ms (A) / 50.3ms (B); exit restored the scene mesh count exactly.
The loading gate is therefore not just a visual transition: it must cover the first rendered frame after addAllToScene, otherwise the expensive upload is visible as a hitch.
caveats: Timings vary between runs (cold vs warm caches, shader compilation, background load). The committed region-loading report is the cold run.
Gate durations are CSS transition times measured in-page; background tabs may throttle transitions.
This is a greybox asset: no KTX2 textures, skinning or animation, so its bytes and decode profile differ from a production region.
